corrections.text: The article quotes HashiCorp describing tfctl's delete-confirmation safeguard as 'designed to prevent autonomous agents from accidentally destroying resources without approval.' HashiCorp's blog post does not contain this sentence. The source's actual wording is: 'Delete commands require interactive confirmation, making them effectively inoperable by autonomous agents, by design.' The underlying fact — that tfctl delete operations require interactive confirmation specifically to guard against autonomous agents — is accurate; the quoted wording attributed to HashiCorp was a paraphrase, not a verbatim quote.
